ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_002.en: Lok’tar! Our mighty Armada will arrive in these waters soon, ushering in our long awaited assault on Lordaeron. All that we have done here has led us to this moment.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_002.tr: Lok'tar！部落强大的舰队即将抵达这片水域，展开期待已久的进攻。我们在这里付出的一切就是为了这一刻！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_003.en: To ensure that the Armada will be operating at maximum efficiency, the Warchief has directed us to begin construction of facilities for them near the Southshore region.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_003.tr: 为了确保舰队以最大效率运作，大酋长命令我们在南海镇附近建造相应设施。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_004.en: He also instructs us to build a fleet of our own, so that we may keep these facilities safe against any Alliance incursions.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_004.tr: 他还让我们打造一支属于自己的舰队，来保护设施安全、抵御联盟侵袭。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_005.en: Accomplishing both of these tasks will require massive amounts of the black liquid known as oil.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_005.tr: 要完成这两项任务，我们就必须拿到被称为原油的黑色液体。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_006.en: The local waters are rich with this resource, and recent ice melts have made it even more of it accessible. But some deposits may be guarded by alliance ships.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_006.tr: 当地水域富含这种资源。这几日冰层已经融化，有利于我们采集。但联盟的船可能会守在油田附近。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_007.en: We will need to build a shipyard and oil tankers in order to extract this resource.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_007.tr: 我们需要建造一座船坞和数艘油船，来提取这些资源。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_008.en: Once our task is completed and our Armada arrives, the invasion of Lordaeron can finally begin… starting with Hillsbrad.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_008.tr: 我们的任务必须赶在舰队到达前完成。终于能进攻洛丹伦了……就从希尔斯布莱德开始吧。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_004.en: I owe you my life, Zul’jin! Thank you for killing those cowardly elves.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_004.tr: 我欠你一条命，祖尔金！谢谢你干掉了那些精灵废物。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_005.en: My pleasure, Rend Blackhand! You and I be brothers now, and brothers be looking out for one another!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_005.tr: 这是我的荣幸，雷德·黑手！我们现在是兄弟，兄弟间就该彼此照应！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_006.en: My axes be thirsting for da blood of da humans and elves who took me, my warriors and I be here to aid ya in the battles ahead!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_006.tr: 我的战斧渴望鲜血、它们想把那些抓走我的人类和精灵剁成肉泥。我和我的战士将在未来的战斗中协助你们！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_007.en: I am glad that you came here. Together we will establish Horde authority over these seas.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_007.tr: 很高兴你能赶来。我们将携手在这片海域建起部落的霸权！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S003_001.en: The pathetic humans got to the island before us! Find their camp and burn it to the ground!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S003_001.tr: 可悲的人类抢先上了岛！找到它们的营地，把它烧个精光！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_001.en: Thanks for freeing us mon! We should hurry, da elves said dat the Gilneans be planning something big!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_001.tr: 谢谢你救了我们，兄弟！我们得快点儿，那些精灵说吉尔尼斯人想搞个大动静！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_002.en: The Gilneans? Chieftain, perhaps we should warn the Armada? Gilneas should not be...
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_002.tr: 吉尔尼斯人？酋长，或许我们该警告舰队。吉尔尼斯人不该……

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_003.en: Nonsense! The Orcish Armada is the greatest naval force in orcish history… if the Gilneans are foolish enough to stand in their way, then let them sail to their doom!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_003.tr: 胡扯！兽人舰队是我族历史上最强大的海军…… 吉尔尼斯人要是胆敢阻挡它的前进，就准备驶向灭亡吧！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S005_001.en: That’s the last of them. Now we can focus on our main task, without hindrance.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S005_001.tr: 这是最后一个了。现在我们能毫无挂碍地投身于主要任务了。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S006_001.en: Dis be the Destroyer. These ships be swift and deadly. Dey can shoot at both ground and air targets. Dey will be indispensable in naval battles with da Alliance.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S006_001.tr: 这就是驱逐舰。这些舰船迅疾且致命。能轻易摧毁地面和空中目标。它们在同联盟海战中不可或缺。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_001.en: Chieftain! There is a force of battleships anchored in Southshore, they could set sail at any moment!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_001.tr: 酋长！有支战略舰队停在了南海镇，随时可能起航！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_002.en: Lok'Narash! They must not be allowed to threaten our operations here, destroy them immediately!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_002.tr: Lok-Narash！不能让它们威胁到我们的行动，立刻消灭它们！

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_001.en: Chieftain, this human tanker carried oil, maybe we can pillage more oil from these pathetic humans?
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_001.tr: 酋长，这艘人类油船满载着原油。或许我们能从这些可悲人类的手中掠得更多的原油？

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_002.en: Excellent idea Utok! This way we can claim even more oil, while striking a crippling blow against our enemies.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_002.tr: 绝妙的想法，乌托克！这样我们就能拿到更多原油，顺便狠狠打击敌人了。

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S009_001.en: Excellent! Our tankers are bursting with oil, now nothing can stop us from destroying Hillsbrad!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S009_001.tr: 完美！我们的油船装满了原油，再也没人能阻挠我们摧毁希尔斯布莱德了！
